headline: Barely there and glassy at dawn, blown by afternoon.
today: Tiny at 0.7-1ft even on a prime SSE angle, with a light W morning before the S onshore ramps up hard by evening. Purely a dawn patrol log if you're already nearby, otherwise a pass. Not worth the 45.

daysToWatch.note: Prime SSE angle at 1.2-1.7ft with N offshore morning — cleanest Lido window of the week, small but fun on a log.
Up to 2.2ft on a prime angle but SW cross-on all day chops it. Manageable early, marginal by afternoon.
